excerpt: Humor, play, fun. These words are bandied about in the press release for The Endless Dance , a sky blue LP that sparkles like spring. The vibrant template of the cover suggests an array of flowers bursting from the earth, the artists cleverly disguised in the collage. Head straight to track two to jump into the fun. This is where Beibei Wang starts reciting a Chinese tongue twister, turning it into a rap-and-clap with Kuai Ban (bamboo clappers). This infectious piece has a chance of going viral,
_cn_summary: 汉娜·皮尔是北爱尔兰跨界电子/古典作曲家兼歌手，贝贝·汪是以快板（木鱼、竹板）等传统中国打击乐著称的旅英打击乐手，两人合作把皮尔的空灵电子声线与汪氏的清脆木板节奏相融合。《The Endless Dance》以春日晴空的蓝天为基调，融合电子氛围、民谣旋律与中文绕口令式的快板说唱，第二首将绕口令转为rap‑clap，极具感染力且具病毒式传播潜力。专辑的亮点在于东西方传统与现代电子的对话：佩尔的柔和人声与汪的节奏感在跳跃节拍中自然交织，形成新颖的跨界舞曲，值得在现场演出中关注。

excerpt: Imagine living in the “best town,” a rural community of friendly neighbors surrounded by natural beauty, and then being forcibly displaced so the government could make nuclear bombs. This is what happened to the shellshocked citizens of Ellenton, South Carolina in 1951. A research project at the nearby Savannah River, testing birds to see if they were still radioactive (they were) prompted the members of Magic Tuber Stringband to compose Heavy Water , a soundtrack to a centuries-spanning tragedy
_cn_summary: Magic Tuber Stringband 是一支来自美国南方的传统弦乐与实验民乐并重的团队，成员以小提琴、班卓、曼陀林等原声乐器为主，擅长将古早的 Appalachian 民谣与美国乡野叙事融合。Heavy Water 以低沉的弦乐交织配合环境音和鸟类采样的“辐射声”，营造出凄凉而宏大的电影感，既保留了老式蓝草的质感，又在声音层次上加入了现代的氛围音场。专辑最值得注意之处在于它以真实的 Ellenton 强制搬迁与 Savannah River 放射性实验为线索，把历史悲剧转化为音乐的记忆体，使听众在沉浸式听感中感受到核时代与自然环境的双重冲击。

excerpt: Sanaya Ardeshir (she/her) is an Indian producer and composer, with a parallel practice in electronic music under the moniker – Sandunes. Like her naturally occurring namesake, her world of sound is in constant evolution-ranging from experimental piano music, acoustic-electronic dance music, to experiments in pop, field recordings and synthesis.
_cn_summary: Sanaya Ardeshir（别称Sandunes）是来自印度的制作人与作曲家，兼具古典钢琴实验与电子舞曲的创作背景。专辑融合实验钢琴、Acoustic‑Electronic 舞曲、流行元素以及现场录音与合成器纹理，呈现出自然流动、层次丰富且氛围感强烈的声场。值得注意的亮点在于她对现场音色的捕捉与数字合成的大胆混搭，使得每首曲目在节奏推进与情绪转折之间保持极高的可听性与创新感。

excerpt: Gridlock‘s Trace returns, and this is a classic industrial IDM release. As a reissue, there’s nothing here that’s reinventing the wheel in regards to production, it was released at a time where this type of sound was innovative and thriving. Heaviness through electronics Trace by gridlock Gridlock‘s Trace returns, and this is a classic industrial IDM release. As a reissue, there’s nothing here that’s reinventing the wheel in regards to production, it was released at a time where this type of sou
_cn_summary: Gridlock是英国早期工业/实验电子双人组合，1990年代在地下场景以极端噪声和碎片化IDM节拍著称；《Trace》最初于1998年发行，以厚重的合成噪声、金属感敲击和紧凑的碎拍为核心，打造出压迫式暗潮氛围，是其最具标志性的工业IDM作品。本次再版通过重新母带提升了低频冲击与细节层次，使原本粗糙的颗粒感更加清晰，成为回顾90年代工业电子冲击力的重要基准。

album: Tyshawn Sorey Piano Concerto “For Marilyn Crispell,” Featuring Aaron Diehl, Has Its Philly-Hosted World Premiere
excerpt: Composer and drummer/multi-instrumentalist Tyshawn Sorey won a 2024 Pulitzer Prize for the stately “Adagio” (dedicated to trumpeter Wadada Leo Smith), one of his numerous acclaimed … Read More "Tyshawn Sorey Piano Concerto “For Marilyn Crispell,” Featuring Aaron Diehl, Has Its Philly-Hosted World Premiere" The post Tyshawn Sorey Piano Concerto “For Marilyn Crispell,” Featuring Aaron Diehl, Has Its Philly-Hosted World Premiere appeared first on JazzTimes .
_cn_summary: 这张专辑出自2024年普利策奖得主、作曲家兼鼓手/多乐器演奏家Tyshawn Sorey之手，以钢琴协奏曲的形式向即兴钢琴巨匠Marilyn Crispell致敬；Aaron Diehl担任钢琴独奏，呈现兼具古典抒情与现代实验的声线。作品融合了Sorey标志性的细腻节奏编织与Diehl流畅的钢琴语汇，营造出层次分明的动态对比，既有低沉的脉冲也有明亮的旋律线条。听感上最大的亮点是钢琴与打击乐器之间的微妙呼应与对抗，让整部作品在爵士的前卫性与古典的结构感之间自由穿梭。

album: Maki celebrates 1 billion Spotify streams ahead of ‘KOLORCOASTER’ tour stops in Singapore & Jakarta
excerpt: Maki has officially surpassed 1 billion all-time streams on Spotify ahead of his upcoming KOLORCOASTER Southeast Asian tour and the release of his new single, ‘habangbuhay pansamantala’ . The milestone follows the success of his debut album, KOLORCOASTER , which spawned fan favourites including ‘Dilaw’, ‘Namumula’, and ‘kahel na langit’. Now, Maki is bringing the world of KOLORCOASTER beyond the Philippines with regional tour stops scheduled for Singapore and Jakarta this June. The artist is set
_cn_summary: Maki（玛基）是菲律宾新锐创作歌手，首张专辑《KOLORCOASTER》在Spotify已突破十亿播放大关。专辑以明亮的流行电子为基调，兼具独立流行的细腻感，主打歌曲《Dilaw》《Namumula》以及《kahel na langit》分别在快节奏舞曲与情感抒情的慢歌之间切换，形成强烈的视听冲击。伴随新加坡与雅加达的东南亚巡演以及新单曲《habangbuhay pansamantala》发布，《KOLORCOASTER》正成为Maki将菲律宾音乐色彩推向区域市场的关键作品。

album: ARTBAT brings 'Upperground' to Malaysia this June with R3HAB, Chris Avantgarde, 7 Skies & Plastik Funk
excerpt: ARTBAT are bringing Upperground to Asia for the first time. Launched by the Ukrainian electronic duo in 2021, Upperground is ARTBAT’s own music label and global event series, built around their emotive, high-impact take on melodic house and techno. The label was created as a home for ARTBAT’s own releases, while also spotlighting rising and established electronic artists. This June, Sunset by NEON: Upperground Malaysia will take over Resorts World Awana, Genting Highlands for the first chapter o
_cn_summary: 乌克兰电子双人组合 ARTBAT 以情感浓郁、冲击力强的旋律 house 与 techno 为标志，2021 年创立自家厂牌 Upperground 并打造为全球现场品牌。此次在云顶高原 Resorts World Awana 举行的“Upperground Malaysia”——Sunset by NEON 的首场亚洲活动，邀请到 R3HAB、Chris Avantgarde、7 Skies 与 Plastik Funk 等新老电音力量，跨流派编排融合黄昏山峦氛围，将柔情的旋律线与 techno 的强劲鼓点交织，营造情绪张力十足、沉浸感强烈的现场听感，值得乐迷重点关注。

excerpt: re[Ø]load presents a focused study in kinetic fragmentation, balancing technical finesse with a visceral, bodily pull that makes its abstract architecture unexpectedly physical. Sharply articulated glitch mechanics Clean Error head James (aka enabl.ed) offers a slight return with his wonderful Bearclaw alias for a third release titled re[Ø]load. The set arrives as a series of brief, clipped sketches of rhythmic tek-funk and gutter-glitch ergonomics, designed to shift perception from head to hips
_cn_summary: Bearclaw（James）是Clean Error的核心人物，以其同名别名推出的第三张EP《re[Ø]load》融合了技术精准的tek‑funk与粗砺的gutter‑glitch音效，形成短促、碎片化的节奏切块；尽管结构抽象，却凭借强烈的律动和身体化的“pull”把听感从理性思考转向直接的舞池冲动。该EP在极紧凑的片段里保持了细腻的技术细节与 visceral 的力度，使其兼具实验性与可跳性，值得关注。

excerpt: Lost Hope Society doesn’t deal in easy optimism. Instead, it locates hope as a kind of underlying signal—constant, even when masked by noise. Like Midsommar, it uses brightness to reveal shadow, and in doing so, turns discomfort into clarity. Sometimes playful, sometimes disquieting Lost Hope Society by The Music Liberation Front Sweden Listening to The Music Liberation Front Sweden on Lost Hope Society feels like stepping into Ari Aster’s Midsommar refracted through analog circuitry—somewhere b
_cn_summary: 瑞典实验电子乐团 The Music Liberation Front Sweden 将传统北欧民谣的原始旋律与模拟合成器的滤波扫频、磁带回响以及故障电子的碎片化节拍相叠加，形成“明亮中潜藏阴影”的声场。《Lost Hope Society》在高频的清脆音色与低频的沉闷噪声之间制造持续的对比，像 Ari Aster《Midsommar》在模拟电路中的折射，时而是欢快的民俗调式，时而是令人不安的失真层，实现从不适感到情绪清晰的情绪递进。该专辑最具价值的亮点在于把“希望的微光”抽象为噪声掩盖下的清晰旋律线，让听者在层层噪声中仍能捕捉到持续的结构感，是北欧实验电子中兼具怪诞美感与深层情感张力的罕见作品。

excerpt: Two of my favorite sonic sculptors converge as F~M, alias of Roel Funcken and Jeroen Bax (aka exm), shaping Fose into four extended chapters that warp and reassemble rhythmic glitch fragments, threaded with fluid collisions of bass pressure, flickering bleeps, and meticulous sound design. Stretched temporal haze Two of my favorite sonic sculptors converge as F~M, alias of Roel Funcken and Jeroen Bax (aka exm), shaping Fose into four extended chapters that warp and reassemble rhythmic glitch frag
_cn_summary: F~M是荷兰资深实验电子制作人Roel Funcken与Jeroen Bax（aka exm）的合作化名，两位在IDM与glitch领域深耕多年，以精准的节奏结构和细腻的声音雕刻著称。 《Fose (Old Technology)》由四段约十分钟的扩展章节组成，将颗粒感glitch节奏碎片扭曲重组，辅以流体低音冲击、闪烁的电子碎点与精密的声纹设计，营造出拉伸的时间雾感。 专辑的亮点在于将老式模拟合成器与磁带痕迹同数字glitch相碰撞，形成细腻而厚重的声场与层层递进的节奏结构，值得对深度实验电子的听者关注。

excerpt: Henri Texier: Healing Songs Veteran French bassist Henri Texier is calling on past compositions of his to be applied as balm to brows fevered by “the current anxiety-provoking atmosphere”. We assume he means a world riven by war and polluted by echoes of a past that still haunts us. His quintet, with guest drummer Manu […] The post Reviewed: Henri Texier | Anat Cohen Quartetinho | Mark Wade Trio | Joe Lovano appeared first on Jazz Journal.
_cn_summary: 《Quartetinho》聚集了法国资深低音提琴手Henri Texier 多首旧作，由兼具竖笛与萨克斯演奏的Anat Cohen 主导四重奏编制，呈现温暖而略带忧伤的抒情爵士，并在旋律中加入地中海式的音阶光晕。Texier 的低音线条稳健且具叙事性，Cohen 以细腻的吹奏技巧点缀其间，嘉宾鼓手Manu 的轻盈节奏进一步强化了专辑“疗愈”氛围，使整张专辑在简练的编制中仍保持情感真挚。整体上，这是一张把过往创作转化为对当代焦虑社会的慰藉、值得细听的作品。

excerpt: When I first heard about this collaboration between The Melvins and Napalm Death, I thought I had a good idea how this was going to sound- but aside from a few tracks, this album sounds nothing like I was expecting. And I think it's fair to say that for the most part, Savage Imperial Death March is a very different beast.
_cn_summary: 这张《Savage Imperial Death March》是美国 sludge/doom 先驱 The Melvins 与英国 grindcore 代表 Napalm Death 的跨界合作，两支乐队分别发挥其标志性的低沉 sludge/doom 节奏和极速 grindcore 爆破，在多数曲目中将两者交替、交织，形成极端与沉重之间的强烈张力。相较于单纯的风格混搭，专辑出人意料地加入了更具实验性的编曲和稍带旋律性的间奏，使整体听感在冲击与压迫之外仍保留可辨识的层次感。整体而言，这是一张兼具破坏力和结构多样性的极端金属碰撞，尤其值得关注的是它如何在大尺度的低沉 riff 与紧凑的快速冲击之间保持平衡。

excerpt: "In this instant-now I'm enveloped by a wandering diffuse desire for marveling and millions of reflections of the sun in the water that runs from the faucet onto the lawn of a garden..." — Clarice Lispector, from Água Viva What defines a duologue? What becomes as elements evaporate, what is contained in an instant's inception, and, as if those miracles were insufficient, what infuses the shared connection of a creative act? Just as Lispector expressed the wonder and ineffability of ordinary mome
_cn_summary: 《Core of Existence》是巴西萨克斯手Ivo Perelman与美国低音提琴手Damon Smith的即兴二重奏专辑，延续Perelman在自由爵士中常见的抒情长句与Smith在低频共振上实验的倾向。全碟以紧凑的对话式即兴为核心，两件乐器在高音滑音、嘶吼、弓弦摩擦与拨奏、低频轰鸣之间不断切换，形成如水流折射般细腻的层次与突发的强力度对撞，使听感在柔软呼吸与尖锐嘶吼之间快速游走。专辑以Clarice Lispector散文《Água Viva》中的意象为结构线索，通过极短的音块与长音的留白营造即兴叙事氛围，突显对瞬间情感的精准捕捉与空间感的刻意留白。
